tests.description: Preserves the complete existing E2E file and appends one same-session journey: initial server error, two held failed retries, then held real-source recovery. Each transition asserts accessible loading, no stale metrics/completion, reusable retry and final server-confirmed freshness; quote rows remain unchanged.

summary: One meaningful AC19.1-7 browser gap is proposed. Existing E2E006 has one failed retry and a separate successful retry; neither proves retry remains functional after successive failed refreshes in the same session. Existing E2E001-010 (50 cases), role/landing and onboarding regressions already cover the remaining browser journeys and are retained verbatim. The new case reuses setup retry-failure synthetic metadata, guarded-test, armReadPlan/releaseRead and the root-owned private filesystem server-read proxy; initial error and each retry use fresh revisions, with every held revision released in finally. No fixtures, tests, product code, specs, dependencies, Git state or managed resources were modified. Tests were not run and no additional browser exploration was launched. Utility mandate is inactive: tea_use_playwright_utils=true, but @seontechnologies/playwright-utils is absent from dependencies/devDependencies. Existing guarded-test remains the correct import; any future utility installation/wiring belongs to a separate framework task, not this story. Pact is irrelevant because no independent consumer/provider boundary exists. Server authority/revocation, HTML/RSC secrecy and all role/accessibility/layout matrices remain covered by existing cases; the overlapping-call seam is owned by worker A.
